system.description:
You have already survived condemnation once. Authority no longer possesses quite the same power over you.

Prerequisites Mental Focus 1 rank

Action R; Trigger You fail a Will saving throw against a Fear, Charm or Compulsion effect.
Frequency Once per day

You may reroll the triggering saving throw. You must use the second result.

If the effect originates from a creature, institution, Divine Aspect or religious tradition responsible for your excommunication or rejection, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to this reroll.

Use: spends the reaction and the day's use, and queues the optional +1 circumstance bonus for the reroll — then reroll the Will save from your sheet.
